title: Segment What It Can Draw: Querying a Text-to-Image Generator with Its Own Images for Skin Lesion Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Skin lesion segmentation without annotated masks requires the target to be specified through other cues. Existing approaches rely on dermoscopy-specific rules, annotation-derived model priors, or user-selected regions. A general text-to-image diffusion transformer offers a text interface to the target, but its concept-word attention is unreliable on dermoscopy images: in the model's attention-output space, the word-derived skin-to-lesion direction is poorly aligned with the direction separating real skin from real lesions. We show that the direction derived from generated healthy-skin and lesion images is substantially better aligned. Based on this finding, we propose GENIQ, a training-free method that constructs initial skin and lesion prototypes from generated images and refines them using the most skin-like and lesion-like patches from unlabelled dermoscopy images. It scores test patches along the refined direction and applies a gat

translated_title: 分割它能画出的东西：用文生图生成器自身的图像来查询它以进行皮肤病变分割
translated_abstract: 无需标注掩码的皮肤病变分割需要通过其他线索来指定目标。现有方法依赖于皮肤镜特有的规则、由标注衍生的模型先验，或用户选择的区域。通用的文本到图像扩散Transformer为目标提供了文本接口，但其概念词注意力在皮肤镜图像上并不可靠：在模型的注意力-输出空间中，由词语衍生的“皮肤到病变”方向与区分真实皮肤和真实病变的方向对齐不佳。我们发现，由该模型生成的健康皮肤图像和病变图像所衍生的方向与该判别方向的对齐程度显著更好。基于这一发现，我们提出了GENIQ，一种免训练方法，它从生成的图像中构建初始的皮肤和病变原型，并利用未标注皮肤镜图像中最像皮肤和最像病变的图像块对原型进行细化。该方法沿细化后的方向对测试图像块进行评分，并应用一个门控……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出免训练方法GENIQ，利用文生图扩散模型自身生成的健康皮肤与病变图像构建更可靠的概念方向，并结合未标注皮肤镜图像中最具代表性的图像块进行细化，从而在无需标注掩码的情况下实现皮肤病变分割。
en_tdlr: GENIQ is a training-free method that queries a text-to-image diffusion model with its own generated healthy-skin and lesion images to derive a more reliable concept direction, refined using the most skin-like and lesion-like patches from unlabeled dermoscopy images, enabling annotation-free skin lesion segmentation.
